title: Christmas at Grandma’s House
about: A warm Christmas tribute to Grandma Lammert's home, where generations gather and family traditions live on.
description: Christmas at Grandma's House captures the familiar feeling of returning to the place where generations gather and the season seems to slow down. From the lights in the windows to the laughter that lasts long after dinner, the song celebrates Grandma Lammert's steady love and the comfort of knowing there is always a place for family. More than decorations or presents, it is the people, memories, and traditions that make this house feel like Christmas.
lyrics: But the warmest glow of all
Is the one inside her home for me.
Every year the door is open,
Just as strong as it is now.
Where the joy begins at dawn.
And we stay ‘til the day is gone.
Peace stays when the night grows long -
Feels like a blessing wrapped in love
One truth still rings so clear -
Is the reason we feel home here.
Where love has lived so long.
For the love you always gave.
